result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but a few elements look visually incomplete or awkwardly clipped, especially near the top-right header and horizontal scroll areas.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right appears blank, showing only a small red notification dot. It looks like an icon or avatar failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon/avatar inside the circle, or remove the circle if it is not interactive.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrolling items are cut off at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” This may be intentional, but it looks abruptly clipped in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel clipping is intentional and provide consistent spacing or a clearer partial-card preview at the edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation overlaps the content area, cutting into the next restaurant card image at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
